name: libcdio
description: libcdio is a library for CD-ROM and CD image access. The associated libcdio-cdparanoia library reads audio from the CD-ROM directly as data, with no analog step between, and writes the data to a file or pipe as .wav, .aifc or as raw 16 bit linear PCM.

user:
case $(uname -m) in
   i?86)
      sed '/CDIO_LSEEK/s/lseek64/lseek/' -i lib/driver/_cdio_generic.c &&
      sed '/CDIO_FSEEK/s/fseeko64/fseek/' -i lib/driver/_cdio_stdio.c ;;
esac
